obligations.source_text: Corrigir o armazenamento de CPF no writer de identidade do aluno para evitar formatos mistos entre o perfil do estudante, o registro do aluno e a projeção de perfil.
obligations.rationale: Normative requirement from issue #494 covered by PR #493 and exact-head validation evidence.

obligations.source_text: Quando `cpf` ou `guardianCpf` for válido, armazenar somente os 11 dígitos nas projeções atualizadas pelo writer de identidade.
obligations.rationale: Normative requirement from issue #494 covered by PR #493 and exact-head validation evidence.

obligations.source_text: Quando `cpf` for inválido, preservar o texto informado após remover espaços externos e deixar a projeção normalizada vazia; `cpf: null` deve limpar os valores correspondentes.
obligations.rationale: Normative requirement from issue #494 covered by PR #493 and exact-head validation evidence.

obligations.source_text: Reenviar o mesmo CPF com outra máscara não deve gerar `IDENTIFIER_NORMALIZED_CHANGED`; o caminho de CPF bloqueante do pré-cadastro deve continuar preservando o valor bruto pendente.
obligations.rationale: Normative requirement from issue #494 covered by PR #493 and exact-head validation evidence.

obligations.source_text: A leitura administrativa deve refletir o valor persistido sem máscara para novos registros. Registros históricos não exigem backfill e a interface continua responsável pela máscara visual.
obligations.rationale: Normative requirement from issue #494 covered by PR #493 and exact-head validation evidence.

obligations.source_text: A documentação de ownership/armazenamento deve registrar a nova regra, e os testes e gates de validação relevantes devem permanecer verdes.
obligations.rationale: Normative requirement from issue #494 covered by PR #493 and exact-head validation evidence.

obligations.source_text: A regressão deve demonstrar CPF válido sem máscara nas projeções atualizadas, `guardianCpf` sem máscara, preservação de CPF inválido, limpeza por `null`, ausência de evento no reenvio semanticamente igual e leitura administrativa coerente.
obligations.rationale: Normative requirement from issue #494 covered by PR #493 and exact-head validation evidence.

structural_invariant_closures.applicability_reason: No structural, canonical-path, precedence, dependency-independence or forbidden-implementation obligation is declared.

read_model_closures.applicability_reason: Administrative readback and historical compatibility are explicitly part of the issue contract.

evidence: aluno-create-read-http.integration.test.ts expects digits-only CPF on readback; historical rows require no backfill.

canonical_source_consistency.applicability_reason: The writer updates multiple representations of the same CPF and they must remain semantically consistent.

evidence: student-identity.service.test.ts asserts aligned cpf values across StudentProfile, Aluno and Profile while invalid cpf keeps normalized projection empty.

documentation_consistency.applicability_reason: The issue updates one ownership/storage statement without renaming routes, roles, defaults, permissions or deprecated contracts.
search_evidence: Related CPF storage and pre-registration documentation reviewed.

evidence: Issue #494 body, PR #493 diff, Validate PR run 36883745066 exact material head.
